verdict.rationale: Audit trails are a fair axis for an expense-management product. However, the evidence pack documents no per-expense history of edits, approvals or policy checks, and nothing about audit-ready logs or exports. It only mentions automated approvals and a generic 'automate compliance' claim, which are adjacent features rather than an audit trail.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit
